chapter: Joining Raeburn and work for other leaders
title: A month with Artie Shaw
summary: Handy subbed for Dodo in Shaw's band in San Diego, and Shaw asked him to get Boyd's band to play under Shaw's name.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What did you do with Artie Shaw?
I played with him for about a month, I guess, in San Diego, at one point. Dodo was his regular pianist, but Dodo was ill.
I saw that band in Chicago with Dodo on it, but Chuck Gentry was playing and Herbie Steward.
Right. So that's how that happened, I worked with him for a month.
You didn't record for the band?
No.

We were starting to talk about certain things. He wanted me to talk Boyd into letting him use the band--our band, that he would take our band out and call it the Artie Shaw Band, but to play our stuff.
That would be somewhat confusing, wouldn't it?
I didn't do it. I told him I didn't think anybody would go for it. But
This is after the band had already established itself musically?
Yeah. Right in that period of being established. There was a lot of talk about the band at the time.
I couldn't understand why he would want it? To play his book I could understand. Or to have you write a new book for him, or something like that. No, I don't understand it either.
He was always a pretty impetuous man.
Exactly.
That was the time when he was with Ava Gardner, when I played with him.
Was that a day-to-day hassle with him?
Tell me about Shaw, your reactions to him.
I just felt that he seemed to be a guy that was amused by everything.
as if he was standing off looking at the world like he had inside information about everything.
Was he easy to get on with?
I had no problem with him at all.
Was it a happy band?
Yes.

Most of the guys had known each other for years, not as a result of playing with that band, most of the guys had worked together in a lot of bands; they were real close and for that reason, they were a happy band.
I didn't pay any attention to the beefs--there were a few beefs, but I can't recall what they were. Generally speaking, it was a content band. He was paying good money, that was for sure.
That band was very successful, that was one of his really successful periods; wasn't it?
Right.
That's even more along the lines why I was so puzzled by his request; I couldn't understand it at all, but that's what he wanted to do.
Shaw had money of his own; didn't he? Wasn't he of some wealth?
I had heard the rumors that he came from a wealthy family, but of my own knowledge I have no idea.
